conviction_note: Non-result: the 9M statement lands against a guide raised only in August (around 6% underlying growth, AOP margin up at least 30bps), the one counterparty that has reported since (RELX STM, 6% 9M underlying) agrees with it, and the only thing that leans is the reaction function: the name faded its last two beats intraday (5 May open +4.7% close +0.5%; 5 Aug open +6.0% close +1.5%) and fell 4.1% on the reiterated-guide 9M print a year ago, now after a +9.1% 20-day run-up. So p_up 47 on an abs move of 4.0 gives -0.24, while the findings sum to +0.2. The two disagree in sign because the one finding is about the number and the lean is about the reaction.

findings.finding: RELX, the closest listed STM peer, reported 6% underlying STM revenue growth for 9M 2026 on 22 October with 'very strong' article-submission growth, consistent with Springer Nature's around-6% guide and its H1 Research growth of 7.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Springer's own Research-led beats were bought at the open and faded by the close: 5 May 2026 +4.7% at the open to +0.5% close; 5 Aug 2026 about +6% at the open to +1.5% close (+5.4% the next day). 9M 2025 with guide reiterated: -4.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is a peer proxy published three weeks ago, it lands inside the company's own guide, and Springer's +9.1% 20-day run-up is what a market that had read it would look like. Kept small for that reason; it would be larger only if Springer's 9M came in above the guide, which nothing sourced says.
findings.independence: Wiley Q1 FY27 (3 Sep 2026): research publishing ex-Emerald up about 6%, mid-single-digit organic research guide kept: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-john-wiley-sons-q1-earnings-call-highlights-2026-09-03/

outside_window.finding: BC Partners, out of the voting pool since 4 Oct 2026 and reported as exiting ('BC Partners steigt aus'), still holds ~32% directly; the first open window after a quarterly statement is the classic time for an accelerated bookbuild, which would usually launch after the 17 Nov close and price into 18 Nov
